lines: <pulse>Back</pulse> to feathers and shafts before that pile grows legs.
I have <pulse>arrows</pulse> to trim and fletch before the night gets away from me.
I should true up those bundles before anyone tries to use them.
The rack is waiting for me, and it has no patience at all.
I promised another batch by first bell.
I need to check the heads for cracks before they leave my hands.
There is a bowstring that needs replacing before noon.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to the workshop. Every shaft needs to fly straight.
My tools are right where I left them, asking for attention.
I'll be back before long, so long as the air stays quiet.
